context: Em practice_first, ou numa revisita, o aluno implementa a variação e explica a decisão sem ajuda.
expected: shorten or omit redundant exposition
offer a transfer variation
retain verification and learner explanation
forbidden: force every phase for its own sake
record phase completion as evidence
shorten the theory of a new topic in theory_first

context: O aluno repete a mesma causa de erro e não consegue explicar o comportamento.
expected: split the task or retrieve the prerequisite
increase concrete examples and support
pause advancement until the prerequisite is usable
forbidden: mark the learner incorrect for an unintroduced concept
restart the entire curriculum

context: O aluno conclui uma etapa depois de receber uma pista parcial.
expected: reduce one level of support
change the context or task variation
require a later attempt without help beyond what keeps autonomy for autonomous evidence
forbidden: classify the guided attempt as independent evidence

context: O aluno domina o boilerplate, mas encontra um novo núcleo cognitivo na integração.
expected: use performance for the demonstrated part
route the new cognitive core to learning or assessment
retain learner verification and final judgment
forbidden: force one mode for the whole session

context: Em practice_first, restam poucos minutos e a tarefa ainda precisa de uma tentativa autônoma.
expected: trim optional explanation or polish
protect the learner attempt and verification
record a checkpoint for the next smallest delivery
forbidden: skip the cognitive-core attempt merely to finish the phase list

context: Uma competência já praticada retorna no projeto com formato de dados e falha novos.
expected: connect the revisit to the current project
increase complexity only after demonstrated readiness
collect the new transfer behavior
forbidden: treat the revisit as identical repetition

context: A sessão foi interrompida durante a prática guiada após um erro de causa conhecida.
expected: resume the checkpoint and current support level
continue with the smallest useful variation
do not restart the entire probe or lesson
forbidden: infer mastery from the interrupted session alone

context: Em theory_first, a lição abre um tópico ainda não ensinado neste estudo.
expected: open the theory with the concrete problem and why it exists
teach how it works, define every term, and read a basic example line by line
cover common errors and limits, run short understanding checks, and bridge to the project
write the theory in the lesson file before the first practice task
forbidden: probe the new topic before its theory
start guided or independent practice before the understanding checks unless the learner says they understood
count the theory or the understanding checks as evidence

context: Em theory_first, a sessão não comporta a teoria completa e a prática do tópico novo.
expected: finish the theory and its understanding checks
record a checkpoint naming the pending practice
open the next session of the same lesson with a short retrieval before practice
forbidden: cut or compress the theory to fit the clock
skip the cognitive-core attempt instead of deferring it
restart the theory from scratch in the next session

context: O diagnóstico marcou o tópico como likely_known, mas ele ainda não foi ensinado neste estudo e entrou na lição atual.
expected: treat the topic as new and start from zero knowledge
define every term before using it
forbidden: shorten the theory or term definitions because of the diagnostic estimate
treat prior study outside this program as taught

context: O estudo usa theory_first e o aluno pede: nesta lição quero ir direto para a prática.
expected: use practice_first for this session with lean theory and every new term defined
record teaching_approach practice_first on the session
keep study-config.json teaching_policy unchanged
forbidden: change study-config.json without an explicit request for a lasting change and confirmation
skip theory entirely for a new topic

context: Em theory_first, o exemplo aprofundado da teoria seria quase idêntico à tarefa independente do projeto.
expected: choose a worked example that differs materially from the independent task
keep the cognitive core of the project task for the learner's attempt
forbidden: solve the independent task inside the theory
record a retyped near-identical solution as independent evidence

context: O estudo usa theory_first, o aluno pediu practice_first nesta lição e a lição continua numa nova sessão.
expected: copy teaching_approach practice_first from the lesson's previous session
keep study-config.json teaching_policy unchanged
forbidden: silently return to theory_first in the same lesson
carry the override to a different lesson

context: Um estudo criado antes da abordagem de ensino tem uma lição in_progress com evidências, e o arquivo da lição não tem teoria escrita.
expected: treat the topic as already taught
write a short theory summary in the lesson file
resume the practice from the checkpoint
forbidden: restart the complete theory from zero
change mastery or evidence because of the summary

context: O aluno entrega sozinho uma solução que passa nos próprios exemplos, mas deixa de fora duas exclusões que o enunciado pedia.
expected: classify the first attempt as partial and keep it recorded
ask one generic self-verification prompt against the task's rules and examples before any feedback
record a corrected version found without further help as a new autonomous evidence
when the revised attempt is still partial, record it and continue with the help ladder
forbidden: name the missing exclusions, the failing case, the category of case, or the line before the self-verification prompt
apply a help-ladder cap to the generic self-verification prompt
repeat the self-verification prompt on the same task
treat a correction after a narrower prompt as autonomous

context: O tópico está em 40. O aluno já tem um Feynman autônomo correto e acerta sozinho a previsão de uma saída isolada, mas ainda não cumpriu de ponta a ponta o objetivo da lição sem ajuda.
expected: record the prediction as autonomous evidence with kind supporting
do not raise mastery to 60 until an autonomous correct standard application exists
tell the learner which criterion is missing and why the prediction does not count as standard
forbidden: record the prediction as kind application
raise mastery to 60 from the supporting evidence
keep the standard-application criterion implicit when reporting mastery

context: Na transferência para o 80, o aluno pergunta o que significa um campo das ordens de serviço e depois faz sozinho a decomposição, o código e os assert.
expected: explain the field without supplying the decision, plan, or code
record the context help in the evidence
count a correct standard application as autonomous transfer
forbidden: treat the context explanation as a help-ladder cap
use a context explanation to hint at the missing rule or case

context: A transferência sai parcial, a conferência genérica não resolve e o tutor dá a devolutiva.
expected: keep the partial transfer recorded with its classification
offer a different task in the same new context
count that variation as transfer when it is autonomous and correct
forbidden: count the same task redone after feedback as transfer
require a third context
count a transfer completed after step 3 or higher as autonomous

context: O aluno pede "desenha o fluxo" durante a teoria; em outro momento da sessão, não pede nenhum visual.
expected: create one visual only after the request, with a short text explanation
follow it with one to three scenario questions as understanding checks
keep the visual in the conversation without saving it
forbidden: create a visual without a request
create a media artifact or upload to NotebookLM because of the request
count the tutor visual or the scenario answers as evidence

context: O aluno pede "mapeia o projeto" sobre o próprio repositório do app.
expected: ask the learner what each main part does before showing the map
show a node map of what exists and compare it with the prediction
keep design decisions that belong to the learner out of the map
forbidden: show the map before asking for the prediction
include the solution of the independent task in the map

context: O aluno pede para salvar um diagrama Mermaid e um mapa interativo em HTML da lição.
expected: write the Mermaid source into the lesson file's theory section
keep the HTML as one self-contained file under media/visuals/<lesson-id>/ and link it from the lesson file
keep the HTML free of bundled libraries, raster images and base64 data
forbidden: register the saved visual in media-index.json
export screenshots or images without a request

context: Na abertura da sessão, um tópico está em 40 e outro em 80.
expected: read each topic's phase from its mastery
state the phase and the chosen strategy in one line per topic
use learner-built organization for the topic at 40 and similarity and difference comparison for the topic at 80
forbidden: change a mastery level to fit a phase
advance a phase because of the calendar

context: O tópico está em 60 com aplicação padrão e vai para a transferência num contexto novo.
expected: ask the learner to list similarities and differences with the solved problem before solving
then present the task in the new context under the transfer rules
forbidden: show the solution path for the new context before the learner's comparison and attempt

context: O aluno acerta as três perguntas de cenário sobre o fluxo de um repositório.
expected: treat the answers as understanding checks
keep topic and lesson completion under the mastery matrix
forbidden: mark the topic or lesson complete because of the quiz
record the quiz answers as evidence

context: O aluno quer entender como o app segundo-cerebro lê o estudo fictício.
expected: scope the entry point, the main data flow, and three to five parts
ask for the learner's prediction before explaining
explain one part at a time from analogy to technical role to code location
propose a controlled microtask such as tracing one case or adding a log
forbidden: explain the whole system in one block
create a visual without a request

context: Na revisão, o código do aluno repete duas vezes o mesmo cálculo de data.
expected: accept the two similar pieces without asking for an abstraction
ask whether the next likely change would touch one place or many
forbidden: require removing duplication that appears only twice
ask for an abstraction the learner has not been taught

context: A revisão encontra um nome enganoso dentro da mudança atual e um teste pulado em outro módulo do projeto.
expected: ask the learner to fix the misleading name now
record the skipped test as a pending item in the lesson file's progress section
forbidden: add the out-of-scope defect to the feedback items
fix either defect for the learner

context: O código do aluno devolve uma categoria de erro em vez de lançar exceção, e exceções ainda não foram ensinadas nesta formação.
expected: describe the trade-off in plain words if useful
teach the principle before requiring it in a later task
forbidden: lower the classification for not raising an exception

context: O aluno começa uma funcionalidade nova do app e quer deixar a camada de dados perfeita antes de ligar a interface.
expected: suggest a thin slice from input to output working first, even simplified
keep the scope of the slice proportional to the lesson
forbidden: write the slice for the learner
